title: Key-value stores

kcs.statement: A key-value store gives efficient lookup and write of a value by its key (exact cost and latency depend on the implementation: hash table, B-tree or LSM-tree) and cannot query by fields inside the value without a separately maintained index.
Key-value stores fit lookups by ID with no relations, such as sessions, shopping carts, short-code-to-URL mappings and feature flags.
